page.overview:
Who is Charlotte Emily?

Charlotte "Charlie" Emily was the daughter of Henry Emily, who was murdered by William Afton after she was locked out of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, possibly turning her into Afton's first victim. Shortly after she was murdered, the Puppet found her body and, due to the rain, deactivated next to her, which allowed Charlie to possess him.

Because Charlie has only appeared in the minigames, her most detailed appearance is in Security Puppet's minigame, which is mostly in black and white. She has light-colored skin and has dark-colored hair tied into a ponytail. Charlie wears a light-colored shirt, dark-colored pants, and dark-colored shoes. She also wears a green bracelet the Puppet responds to.

Even though Charlie's appearance in the "Take Cake to the Children" minigame changes in the Security Puppet minigame, she retains a crying facial expression that shows her emotional state. The more rudimentary graphics depict her as wearing a blue shirt, blue pants, and brown shoes. Unlike other minigame children, she is not bald in the minigame.

Henry describes her as a caring, selfless, and noble person that constantly puts others before herself. Henry states it was always in her nature to protect the innocent, with this trait persisting even after possessing the Puppet. When facing a deadly situation, she is shown crying before her death, indicating that she was incapable of defending herself and is fearful when facing danger.
